title: C4OS Grill Question 002 - Plugin Backend Authority

questions.label: How should C4OS app plugins access backend authority in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: route user-impacting plugin actions through a C4OS gateway with plugin-scoped capabilities. This lets built-in plugins be installed but disabled, keeps approvals/audit centralized, and prevents Tauri command exposure from becoming the product authority model.
options: Each app plugin owns direct Tauri command namespaces
Hybrid: direct read-only commands, gateway for mutating or sensitive actions

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether disabled plugins must block backend calls, whether Tauri plugins are compiled/registered anyway, or whether any plugin actions can bypass the C4OS gateway.
